## Release / PR title checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits: `type(scope): short summary`.
- [ ] If this is user-facing, the title uses `fix`, `feat`, or `perf` so Release Please can create release notes.
- [ ] If GitHub squash merge is used, the squash commit title will keep the same conventional format.

Examples: `fix(repairs): close modals on Escape`, `feat(purchases): add supplier order draft flow`, `ci(release): validate PR titles`.
